Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru is a known habitat for crocodiles, and sightings have been reported multiple times over the years. [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] For example, a crocodile was spotted on the bank of the lake in January 2026, triggering panic among morning walkers. [1] Another sighting was reported in December 2024. [2] In 2010, a giant crocodile was spotted on the lake bund. [5] There are also reports of a crocodile found dead in the lake in April 2017. [6] [7] While the claim specifies two crocodiles were sighted on October 6, 2026, the provided search results do not contain information about a specific sighting of two crocodiles on that exact date. However, the presence of crocodiles in the lake is well-documented. [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]
